description: This file contains a single exported asynchronous function `getCountryFromIP` that takes an IP address as input, calls an external IP geolocation API, processes the response to extract country information, and returns a string containing the country name prefixed with a flag emoji.

methods.name: getCountryFromIP
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches geolocation data for a given IP address and returns a string with the country name prefixed by a flag emoji.
